rebalance.trigger: 距上次 run 2 个月 + 首次用 v5.2 probe harness fresh run(6 源 union 167 → 过三闸 50 → biotech-researcher ×10 批评分 → Top20)。
rebalance.trigger_en: Two months since the prior run + first v5.2 probe-harness fresh run (167 union → 3 gates → 50 → biotech-researcher scoring → Top20).
rebalance.logic: 卖点 = 驱动本轮上涨的催化剂已兑现(掉出 fresh-run Top20 = 无 30–120 天临床催化窗口),非裸涨幅;CRNX 为 PM 主观利润落袋,引擎仍认 Elite。
rebalance.logic_en: Sell = the catalyst that drove the run has played out (dropped out of the fresh-run Top20 = no 30–120d clinical window left), not raw price gain. CRNX was a discretionary profit-take; the engine still rates it Elite.
rebalance.composition: 22 支等权(~4.55%/支)= 6 继续持有 + 16 新建仓(14 引擎 + 2 人工主观加入 ALNY/GPCR),换掉 v5 的 14 支。

CRNX.note: +118% 人工清仓落袋(引擎仍认 Elite #7)

triage.note: 催化剂闸(CT.gov PCD)有结构盲区,看不见 PDUFA / 管理层 guided 时点。用管理层电话会 transcript 对『过 Gate0 但被催化剂闸刷掉』的新面孔 triage:8 支 → 4 支确认近期催化 → 2 支补跑评分够格进榜(DNLI 8.28 / MLYS 7.90),换掉最弱两只 WVE / CORT。
triage.note_en: The catalyst gate (CT.gov PCD) is structurally blind to PDUFA / management-guided dates. Management-call transcripts triaged fresh faces that passed Gate 0 but were cut by the gate: 8 → 4 confirmed near-term catalysts → 2 re-scored back into the book (DNLI 8.28 / MLYS 7.90), swapping out the two weakest, WVE / CORT.

rebalance.risk: 2026-08 催化剂拥挤(XENE 抑郁 / MIRM 丁肝);新池多 FIC 早期单资产票(QURE / RAPP),建仓前做 kill-criteria 复核。
rebalance.risk_en: Aug-2026 catalyst crowding (XENE MDD / MIRM HDV); the new sleeve is heavy on early single-asset FIC names (QURE / RAPP) — kill-criteria review before sizing.

rulebook.positioning: 设计起点:数字是『先验合理值』非回测最优值,须走前瞻账本 vs 死等权影子对照验证后才升级『已验证』。
rulebook.positioning_en: Design baseline: numbers are prior-reasonable, not backtest-optimal — promoted to 'validated' only after a forward ledger vs dead-equal-weight shadow control.
rulebook.core: biotech 收益 = 催化剂之间的价格漂移 + 读出时刻的二元跳空。唯一确定有 edge 的动作 = 围绕 readout 日历做事(读出前削已 run-up 的赢家、锁负 skew 尾部);唯一确定该禁的 = 任何价格止损 / 止盈。等权先行,攒够样本再谈分层。
rulebook.core_en: Biotech return = price drift between catalysts + the binary gap at readout. The only sure edge = act around the readout calendar (trim run-up winners pre-readout, cap the negative-skew tail); the only sure prohibition = any price stop-loss / take-profit. Equal-weight first; tier only after enough samples.

rules.title: 单票集中度上限
rules.desc: 权重漂到 ≥7% → 削回 5.5%;读出前硬顶 ≤5.5%
rules.desc_en: Drift to ≥7% → trim to 5.5%; hard cap ≤5.5% into a readout

rules.title: 靶点 / 赛道集中度
rules.desc: 同靶点或机制合计 ≤15%,同适应症 ≤20%

rules.title: 读出前削 run-up
rules.desc: 读出前 2–4 周 run-up ≥+30% → 削回 4.55%;平台重估型例外不削
rules.desc_en: Run-up ≥+30% in the 2–4 wks before readout → trim to 4.55%; platform-rerate winners exempt

rules.title: 清仓红旗(越级)
rules.desc: 临床失败 / 安全信号 / 现金 runway<12月 / 内部人异常减持 / 被并购 → 无条件清
rules.desc_en: Trial fail / safety signal / cash runway <12m / abnormal insider selling / acquired → unconditional exit

rules.title: 评分掉档 → 人工 review
rules.desc: 基本面坏才动,价格噪音不机械砍,只触发人来看一眼
rules.desc_en: Act only if fundamentals worsened; price noise triggers a look, not an auto-cut

rules.title: 密集期现金 buffer
rules.desc: 已知密集读出窗口前 30 天留 5–8% 现金,接读出后错杀标的
rules.desc_en: Hold 5–8% cash for 30d ahead of known dense readout windows

rules.title: 流动性执行约束
rules.desc: 单票调仓 ≤20 日 ADV 的 10–15%,建 / 清仓分 3–5 日 VWAP
rules.desc_en: ≤10–15% of 20-day ADV per name; build/exit over 3–5 days VWAP

rules.title: 记账 + 死等权影子对照
rules.desc: 每次动仓记 6 字段,并行记『死等权不调仓』影子组分辨规则真 edge
rules.desc_en: Log 6 fields per move; run a dead-equal-weight shadow book to isolate the rules' real edge

avoid.why: 日波动 4–6%,止损线天天被打穿;真利空 gap 一夜到位,两头挨打
avoid.why_en: 4–6% daily swings punch through stops daily; real bad news gaps overnight — you lose both ways

avoid.why: 评分未经 OOS 验证前,分层 = 把未验证信号当真下注
avoid.why_en: Before OOS validation, tiering bets on an unproven signal

avoid.why: 小盘单笔冲击成本达 45bps,频繁调仓 = 纯漏损;月频查 band
avoid.why_en: Small-cap impact cost hits 45bps; frequent turns are pure leakage — check the band monthly

rulebook.phase_note: Phase 1(现在):8 条风控硬约束,不需数据积累、抗过拟合。Phase 2(攒 ≥30 次 readout 样本后):前瞻账本证明『削 run-up』组 vs 死等权为正 → 再升级等权→两档→三档分层。
rulebook.phase_note_en: Phase 1 (now): 8 hard risk constraints, no data needed, overfit-resistant. Phase 2 (after ≥30 readout samples): if the forward ledger shows 'trim run-up' beats dead-EW → then upgrade equal-weight → two tiers → three tiers.
